title: Calibrate the tilted axes
promptMarkdown: For a boost with $v=4c/5$, find the unprimed coordinates $(ct,x)$ of the unit points on the $ct\prime$ and $x\prime$ axes. Verify their norms and mutual inner product. Transform the event $(ct,x)=(7,5)\,\mathrm m$ to $S\prime$ and verify its interval in both frames. Explain how to locate it graphically without Euclidean perpendicular projection.
hintLadder: Set $x\prime=0$ for one axis and $t\prime=0$ for the other.
The Lorentzian unit conditions use a difference of squares.
Apply the Lorentz equations directly as an algebraic check of the sketch.

criteria.criterion: Axis calibration and Lorentz orthogonality are correct.
